P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor present; the page relies entirely on typography and abstract graphics.

P05.rationale: The layout contains no case study sections with client portraits or named examples of specific business achievements.

P07.rationale: A single testimonial quote is present in the top section, but it lacks a supporting visual apparatus like logos or rating cards to build social proof.

P10.rationale: Large decorative typographic elements are used effectively, specifically the giant '40%' figure and the large ghosted numbers at the bottom.

P11.rationale: The page features a specific data visualization (the '40%') bound to real-world context regarding large enterprises, rather than an empty chart frame.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, utilizing the full sheet with text columns, graphics, and typography without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: A subtle dark blue background texture provides atmosphere, though it remains relatively flat compared to more complex editorial treatments.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos overlaid with text on this page, so the criterion for treating images is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups (such as phones or laptops) are shown to add credibility to the content.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists of abstract geometric shapes and generic typography rather than specific photos of a real business environment.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with text blocks and graphical elements filling most of the page.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without a scrim because there are no photographic backgrounds overlaid with text in this design.
